contract: POST /api/items/batch/scan is the admin batch item scan: with a non-empty libraryItemIds array that matches at least one item it answers 200 and rescans each folder item asynchronously, skipping file items; a non-admin answers 403 and an empty or fully unmatched id list answers 400; rejected requests rescan nothing.
evidence: go-backend/testmachine/scenarios/scan: 4 upstream scenarios, all passing in two consecutive full packet runs
exceptions: force is not applicable: POST /api/items/batch/scan has no force or override parameter; every listed folder item is rescanned unconditionally.
The 200 response body is the reason phrase Express sends for sendStatus(200); clients do not read it, so scenarios assert the status only.

invariants.contract: The route is admin-only and answers 200 for a non-empty libraryItemIds list (rescans each folder item through LibraryItemScanner.scanLibraryItem, skips file items), 403 for a non-admin, and 400 for an empty list or ids that match no item; each accepted item takes its edited metadata.json values and the rejected requests leave rows and sidecars unchanged.
